description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Activate General's Regalia by paying {3}, choosing to redirect the next damage Volcano Hellion does to you to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve Volcano Hellion's ability, dealing an arbirarily large amount of damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to target opponent.
